source_title: How I Got My First Gumroad Sale Again
source_date_if_available: Accessed April 2026; content references May 1, 2025 sale
snippet_primary: "I know Gumroad can be a big earner, but I just haven't got the confidence to sell my stuff yet. The easiest thing to mess with our head is how to price our product or services, and how much the buyer is really willing to pay?"
subject_exact: Seller-reported psychological barrier to pricing on Gumroad and uncertainty about buyer willingness to pay
